title: Urology and Continence Supply Program refill cycle and hold limits
content:
Every tier of the Urology and Continence Supply Program ships on a refill cycle. The cycle sets the standard supply in one shipment, the timing of reminders and early shipping, whether the customer confirms each refill, how two programs' refills are brought together, and how long a program may stay on hold. All day counts are calendar days.

## Terms

- **Standard supply per shipment**: the standard days of supply in one refill shipment. It is always a multiple of 30.
- **Reminder lead**: the earliest point for Larkfield's refill-reminder contact, in calendar days before the planned ship date.
- **Early-ship lead**: the earliest point a refill may ship, in calendar days before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of the same item.
- **Refill confirmation required**: whether each refill needs the customer's own confirmation of continued use and of the quantity on hand before it ships. No means subscription shipping on schedule.
- **Consolidation span**: refills of a customer's two continence programs ship together on the later date when their earliest ship dates fall within this many calendar days of each other.
- **Inpatient hold required**: whether shipments must be held while the customer is an inpatient in a hospital or skilled nursing facility, because the payer does not pay for home supplies during a covered stay.
- **Hold limit**: the longest time a program may remain on hold, in calendar days counted from the hold start date, before it is closed administratively.

## Schedule

| Basis | Continence Self-Pay Program | Continence Commercial HMO Program | Continence Commercial PPO Program | Continence Medicare Advantage Program | Continence Original Medicare Program | Continence Medicaid Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard supply per shipment (days) | 30 | 30 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 30 |
| Reminder lead (days before planned ship date) | 7 | 10 | 10 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| Early-ship lead (days before previous supply ends) | 7 | 7 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 7 |
| Refill confirmation required | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Consolidation span (days) | 7 | 10 | 10 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| Inpatient hold required | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Hold limit (days from hold start) | 180 | 60 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 60 |


## Points of reading

- A standard supply of 90 days is three 30-day blocks, and a standard supply of 30 days is one block.
- The Continence Self-Pay Program ships on subscription without a per-refill confirmation. It is also the only tier with no inpatient hold.
- **Hypothetical example:** a 90-day tier with a 10-day early-ship lead. If the previous refill's supply ends on day 90 after its ship date, the earliest permitted date for the next refill is day 80.
